stock.description: Vision Values Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of network solutions and project services in Hong Kong, Mainland China, and Mongolia. It is involved in the property investment, minerals exploration businesses, private jet management services; logistics services; and others. It also engages in lease related businesses. Vision Values Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
